Third-party files served by this site

These files are copied unmodified (except where noted) from the npm packages named below, so that visitors' browsers never contact another company's servers. Each licence text is in the licenses/ folder and must stay with the files.

Inter (variable, Latin and Latin Extended subsets), fonts/inter-*.woff2
  Package: @fontsource-variable/inter 5.3.0 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource-variable/inter)
  Upstream: https://github.com/rsms/inter
  Copyright 2016 The Inter Project Authors
  Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (licenses/inter-OFL-1.1.txt)

Space Grotesk (variable, Latin subset), fonts/space-grotesk-latin-wght-normal.woff2
  Package: @fontsource-variable/space-grotesk 5.3.0 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk)
  Upstream: https://github.com/floriankarsten/space-grotesk
  Copyright 2020 The Space Grotesk Project Authors
  Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1 (licenses/space-grotesk-OFL-1.1.txt)

KaTeX 0.16.9, katex/
  Package: katex 0.16.9 (https://www.npmjs.com/package/katex)
  Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
  Copyright (c) 2013-2020 Khan Academy and other contributors
  Licence: MIT (licenses/katex-MIT.txt)
  Changes: katex.min.css lists only the WOFF2 font files (the WOFF and TTF fallbacks were removed); the fonts folder holds only the WOFF2 files. katex.min.js is unchanged.

fonts/fonts.css was written for this site and declares the font families.
